say.text: The siege goes on. Shirkuh is in Upper Egypt. No word comes from him.
The Alexandrians on the east wall asked me how long the bread will last, my lord. I said I did not know.
It will last until it does not. That is the only honest answer, and you gave it. Tell them: it will last a day longer than Shawar's patience.
Shall I tell them that you say so?
Tell them that. They had better hear it from a man they have seen on the wall.
